phase_name: Ops Dispatch — Live Board, Assignment & Account Surfaces

Phone booking pay.question: How does a phone booking get paid?
Phone booking pay.answer: Stripe like the site — quote, then card or email pay-link; webhook confirms. No mark-paid-outside-Stripe.

Phone booking pay.question: Who types the card?
Phone booking pay.answer: Both — customer on pay-link page, or dispatcher takes card in ops on the call.

Phone booking pay.question: Unpaid phone booking on the board?
Phone booking pay.answer: Yes — unpaid/pending, same as public checkout.

Phone booking pay.question: When does pay-link email go out?
Phone booking pay.answer: When dispatcher clicks Send / Email a pay link. Resend allowed, same Stripe session.

Phone booking pay.question: Who is the customer?
Phone booking pay.answer: Type name/email/phone like guest checkout. Matching account email sees it. No forced #customers row.

Phone booking pay.question: Card in ops fails or hang up?
Phone booking pay.answer: Leave unpaid — Send pay-link still works.

Phone booking pay.question: Extras?
Phone booking pay.answer: Same as checkout — child seat, extra stop, oversize, ski request.

Phone booking pay.question: Email language?
Phone booking pay.answer: Dispatcher picks EN/DE/FR/AR on the booking.

Phone booking pay.question: Pickup/dropoff?
Phone booking pay.answer: Same as the site — Mapbox places, same quote engine.

Phone booking pay.question: Company billing?
Phone booking pay.answer: Same as checkout — optional company + VAT, whoever pays first.

Phone booking pay.question: Flight number?
Phone booking pay.answer: Same as the site — optional, same lookup when it works.

Phone booking pay.question: Resend pay-link?
Phone booking pay.answer: Yes — same unpaid Stripe session, new email.

Dashboard tiles.question: Live vs mock?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Nothing stays mock. Every tile is live data.

Dashboard tiles.question: Income/average set?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Captured fares only (webhook paid). Average uses that same set.

Dashboard tiles.question: Period filter?
Dashboard tiles.answer: One header Today / 7 days / 30 days. Money uses captured date. Operation/Needs attention/Fleet use Zurich pickup date.

Dashboard tiles.question: Needs attention?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Unassigned paid + unpaid/pending. No #support tickets here.

Dashboard tiles.question: Refunds?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Income stays the capture. Refund is a Money-out line labelled Refund.

Dashboard tiles.question: Fleet today?
Dashboard tiles.answer: On-shift chauffeurs + in-service vehicles from Phase 6 fleet. Empty = real zeros.

Dashboard tiles.question: Money in lines?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Vehicle class (Economy / Business / Van) from captured fares.

Dashboard tiles.question: Currency?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Always CHF. No FX switcher on dashboard.

Dashboard tiles.question: Money-out kinds?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Real action kinds only. Refund labelled Refund. Stripe fee labelled Stripe fee. Expenses tile CHF 000 until a later cost sheet. No fake chauffeur/vehicle/fee rows.

Dashboard tiles.question: Stripe fee?
Dashboard tiles.answer: Income stays gross. Stripe fee is Money-out. Net = income − fees − refunds. No double-count. Fee from Stripe on the captured charge; missing fee = no line.

Board refresh.question: When payment/assign lands?
Board refresh.answer: Update in place — no full reload.

Board refresh.question: Ping?
Board refresh.answer: Silent — numbers and rows just change.

Board refresh.question: Open detail?
Board refresh.answer: Update in place — same as the board.

Board refresh.question: Where live-updates apply?
Board refresh.answer: Every open Ops hash (dashboard, board, calendar, detail, customers, fleet chauffeur page) plus signed-in customer /bookings and trip detail. Confirmation wait room already waits on webhook. Home/marketing does not. No live GPS.

Assign.question: How assign?
Assign.answer: Pick chauffeur only. Linked vehicle comes with them. DB refuses chauffeur overlap. No vehicle = fail honestly. No typed names.

Assign.question: Assign before paid?
Assign.answer: No — paid/confirmed only. Unpaid stays on the board with no chauffeur.

Assign.question: Unassign?
Assign.answer: Yes — chauffeur comes off, trip goes back to unassigned.

Assign.question: Picker list?
Assign.answer: Only chauffeurs whose vehicle can take this trip’s pax and bags.

Assign.question: Double-book click?
Assign.answer: Name the other trip (ref + time) and refuse.

Assign.question: Already assigned, someone else?
Assign.answer: Pick the new chauffeur in one step — old one comes off.

Assign.question: Customer sees chauffeur?
Assign.answer: Yes — fleet row name + vehicle, never fake. Empty until assigned.

Assign.question: Notify chauffeur?
Assign.answer: Email the chauffeur on assign and unassign with the trip. Language from the fleet row. No driver app.

Assign.question: No email on fleet row?
Assign.answer: Cannot assign until an email is saved.

Assign.question: Fleet Save?
Assign.answer: Must actually persist. Vehicle pairing is required for assign.

Assign.question: Chauffeur page?
Assign.answer: Click chauffeur in #fleet — page with profile + live trips. Assign/unassign from there too.

Assign.question: Vehicle off the road with upcoming assigned trips?
Assign.answer: Allowed. Those trips become must-fix on Needs attention. Ops email. Dispatcher assigns a new chauffeur (vehicle follows) or pairs this chauffeur with a working vehicle. Trip is not auto-cancelled.

deferred_ideas: Cost sheet / expense tracking so dashboard Expenses is more than a live zero — own phase, not Phase 8
